title: Ash & Aether: The Unfinished Song
scope: Three-act native SNES campaign: 24 chapters, persistent companion and settlement consequences, sparse branching techniques and authored two-phase boss AI. Native map/art templates are retained.

missions.title: The Stolen Song
missions.briefing:
Nells father lost his voice
at the festival. His song is
in the loading-yard glass.
Enter through Rooks hatch.
missions.intro:
SENTINEL: The workers voices
are registered power assets.
IONA: He has a daughter.
ROOK: Keep heat. Cut it free.
missions.clear:
The glass releases his song.
Nells father can speak again.
He gives you a carriage docket.
Other prisoners leave at dawn.
missions.debrief:
FATHER: Brass drives the train.
He leaves a refuge unlocked
beneath the glass viaduct.
Find him. Bring them all home.

The prisoner carriage escaped.
Nells father is in the cells.
Keep heat. Free his voice.

Break that machine for us.

missions.title: The Dawn Carriage
missions.briefing:
The stolen-song docket leads
to the glass viaduct. Brass
keeps a refuge under its west
end. Find him before the warden.
missions.intro:
WARDEN: Unload the voices.
BRASS: There are people inside.
WARDEN: You signed the docket.
BRASS: Then I can tear it up.
missions.clear:
Brass opens every carriage.
A boy clings to his mother.
The manifest lists river tests,
not crimes. Riven signed it.
missions.debrief:
BRASS: The drain below this
viaduct reaches Rivens well.
Ask why he signed the tests.
I will help carry the answer.

Drain: opens after the rescue.

He is just afraid.
objects.after:

The carriage code is 0-9-1.
I will not drive it again.

missions.title: Chapel of Rain
missions.briefing:
ROOK: Orison erased this
quarter from every city map.
The chapel kept a witness.
Hear the song they buried.
missions.intro:
The broken bells answer.
A keeper made of stolen ash
rises between the pillars.
The witness is behind it.
missions.clear:
The witness remembers a name:
Director Veyr built the engine
to bring his daughter home.
Recovered: 400 credits.
missions.debrief:
HESPER: The bells let me speak.
Mira hid the stolen names
in the archive east of here.
Take my account to her.

missions.title: Names in the Archive
missions.briefing:
MIRA: The archive stores
every name taken by Orison.
They call the erased debtors.
I call them my family.
missions.intro:
INDEX SHADE: This record
has been sealed by the board.
MIRA: Then the board can
come down here and stop us.
missions.clear:
Thousands of names shine.
Your names are here as well.
The city itself was collateral.
Recovered: 450 credits.
missions.debrief:
MIRA: These orders bear
Veyrs seal. His office is
above the sky-engine dock.
We need his answer, not a name.

rooms.entry_text:
The archive vaults. Mira said
the index terminal is in the
east wing. Ledgers move in
the dark like animals.

objects.text: Ledger mites skitter close.

Paper settles like snow.

objects.text:

Seal the record last. Keep

Here is my access key.
objects.after:

They kept the names here
that even the board feared.
We leave no voice behind.

missions.title: The Sky Engine
missions.briefing:
BRASS: The sky engine pulls
our memories up to the spire.
Veyr has cut his own chains.
He is waiting on the catwalk.
missions.intro:
VEYR: No. Just Veyr.
I gave the board a door.
They made it a mouth.
Help me close what I opened.
missions.clear:
The marshal falls. Veyr frees
the engine from its moorings.
The spire begins to drift.
Recovered: 500 credits.
missions.debrief:
VEYR: I built it for my child.
Orison made a city feed it.
Corins orchard kept a living
seed. We need another power.

to find my daughter. Set the
brake before releasing both

the drift. I go with you.

missions.title: Orchard After Fire
missions.briefing:
SABLE: This was my home.
Orison burned it for the vein
under the roots. I stood guard.
Today I open the way home.
missions.intro:
The roots hold a living seed.
It carries every stolen voice
from the first extraction.
Its pain has learned to fight.
missions.clear:
Iona places the seed in water.
The orchard starts to green.
The voices choose to stay.
Recovered: 600 credits.
missions.debrief:
CORIN: The seed holds voices
without glass. Take it into
the reactor. Give the city
a choice besides cold or chains.

to go home to.

lines.2:
DARA: You pulled us out of
the glass at Furnace Nine.
I keep the Kiln's lights on.
lines.4:
DARA: The train families
sleep in the lower hall.
It feels like a town now.
lines.7:
DARA: Veyr? I worked his
engine. If he fights for us,
I can live with that.
lines.9:
DARA: The furnaces are cold.
I sleep the whole night now.

variants.text:
DARA: We ran on reserve air.
The drones are dead, but we
need the medics here tonight.

DARA: You kept our air alive.
The drones still haunt the
factory. We remember both.

DARA: Our voices came home.
Iona's sheltering phrase
kept us together in the dark.

lines.3:
TILLY: Brass carried me off
the train. He says his hands
remember work, not war.
lines.4:
TILLY: Riven taught me to
swim in the clean channel!
lines.9:
TILLY: When I grow up I will
keep the river clean.

lines.5:
HESPER: Forty years I rang
those bells. Thank you for
letting them ring again.
lines.6:
HESPER: Mira read my husband's
name from the archive.
I had forgotten his voice.
lines.9:
HESPER: Every name came home.
I ring the bells at dusk.

lines.7:
OREN: I guarded the sky
engine. I put down my badge
when the moorings broke.
lines.9:
OREN: No more guards.
Just neighbours.

chapters.goal: Break the command post and open a route for unarmed refugees.

chapters.goal: Separate the mountain voices instead of forcing them into unison.

chapters.goal: Recover the broken lens and find a path the network cannot predict.

chapters.goal: Open the wind locks and make the cargo crossing safe for people.

chapters.goal: Release the testimony and choose whether to protect its names.

chapters.goal: Preserve the old marks in the first collector and break its perfect mold.

chapters.goal: Free the trapped miners and turn the intake outward.
chapters.discovery: The workers reveal the assembly where the city must choose its next keeper.

chapters.goal: Give the city a public archive or river school, then open the Choir hand.
chapters.discovery: The city answers before the Choir can issue its final command.

chapters.goal: Answer the Choir with living voices and leave room for another answer.
